citation: Chicago 1835 Best Resident Set Research v4 — working synthesis of 1833–1835 poll/tax evidence, 1839/1843 directories, and the 1840 census/IPUMS crosswalk.
rights_note: This file is the project's own adjudication table, derived from the public-domain 1840 U.S. Census population schedules for Chicago and from the 1833-1835 poll and tax lists already held in this corpus. Nothing in it is reproduced from a rights-bearing work; the workbook it was recovered from was project-authored. Textual and derivative use are unrestricted.
note: Recovered adjudication from Chicago_1835_Best_Resident_Set_Research_v4.xlsx. It is a research bridge, not a substitute for the underlying primary sources. Direct/high-confidence 1835 identities are promoted only where the workbook records direct early-list evidence and a resolved 1840 row/SERIAL; 1840 household composition remains later evidence.
